claims.claim: A policy that has not reached a device is not enforced there.
claims.quote: Policies that are updated while a device is offline won't be pushed to that device. Similarly, such policies won't be enforced on that device, until the device is back online. However, the outdated policy that exists on the offline device will still be enforced.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Per-device configuration and policy-sync status are available in Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Device onboarding > Devices.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Settings (gear icon in the upper right corner) > Device onboarding > Devices.

claims.claim: DeviceInfo | where DlpInfo != "" is a read-only query for Endpoint DLP device data, not a control over the AI capability.
claims.quote: Sample query: DeviceInfo | where DlpInfo != "" | project DlpInfo

claims.claim: The query runs in Microsoft Defender portal > Investigation & response > Hunting > Advanced hunting.
claims.quote: Go to the Microsoft Defender portal. Navigate to Investigation & response > Hunting > Advanced hunting

claims.claim: DlpInfo in DeviceInfo reports configuration validity.
claims.quote: IsDlpConfigurationValid | boolean | Indicates whether the device configuration health is valid.

claims.claim: DlpInfo reports the most recent DLP policy modification time associated with a device.
claims.quote: DlpPolicyLastModifiedTimeUTC | datetime | Timestamp of the most recent DLP policy modification associated with the device, in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

claims.claim: The device health dashboard is at Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Device onboarding > Device report.
claims.quote: Go to the Microsoft Purview portal. Select Settings > Device onboarding > Device report.

claims.claim: Dashboard readiness indicators flag risk of missing future updates, not confirmation of a failed policy update.
claims.quote: These indicators don't confirm whether a device failed to receive a policy update, but instead highlight devices that may be at risk of not receiving future updates.

claims.claim: The Security Copilot FAQ says it currently is not designed for US government-cloud customers.
claims.quote: Currently, Security Copilot isn't designed for use by customers using US government clouds, including but not limited to GCC, GCC High, DoD, and Microsoft Azure Government.
